titleByLocale.en: Primary School Teacher or Special Education Teacher

jobs.description:
Das Heilpädagogische Schulzentrum (HPSZ): Eine Schule - vier Standorte. Wir unterrichten und fördern unsere Schülerinnen und Schüler vom Kindergartenalter bis zum Schulaustritt ganzheitlich und individuell. Unser vielfältiges pädagogisches Angebot ermöglicht eine gute schulische, soziale und persönliche Entwicklung. Für das HPSZ Solothurn suchen wir per 01.08.2026 befristet bis 31.07.2028 eine/-n Primarlehrer/-in oder Heilpädagoge/Heilpädagogin, 83%.

Ihre Verantwortung

• Als ausgebildete Lehrperson begleiten Sie unsere Schüler und Schülerinnen im Zyklus 1 im kantonalen Spezialangebot SpezA VK, welche einen speziellen Förderbedarf haben.

• Sie sind verantwortlich für den Unterricht, die Förderplanung, sowie organisatorische und administrative Arbeiten im Zusammenhang mit der Klassenführung.

• Das Klassenteam unter Ihrer Führung besteht aus pädagogischen Mitarbeiter/-innen sowie einem Praktikanten/einer Praktikantin.

• Mit Eltern, Fachstellen, Therapeuten/ Therapeutinnen, anderen Institutionen sowie der Schulleitung arbeiten Sie eng zusammen.

• Bei Schulentwicklungsprojekten zählen wir auf Ihre Mitarbeit.

Ihr Profil

• Sie haben eine pädagogische Grundausbildung (Primarstufe) evtl. mit heilpädagogischer Zusatzausbildung.

• Im Sonderschulbereich haben Sie bereits Erfahrung oder sind bereit, sich auf Kinder mit besonderen Bedürfnissen einzulassen.

• Die individuelle Förderung unserer Schüler und Schülerinnen ist für Sie nicht nur ein Beruf, sondern eine Berufung.

• Im Umgang mit Kindern und deren Eltern sind Sie geduldig, klar und wertschätzend; ein Sinn für Humor rundet Ihr Profil ab.

• Als kreative, begeisterungsfähige Person schätzen Sie interdisziplinäre Teamarbeit und wirken gerne an der Weiterentwicklung der Schule mit.

• Förderung der persönlichen Work-Life-Balance durch ein Jahresarbeitszeitmodell

• Teilzeitarbeit, auch im Kader

• Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten

• Fortschrittliche Anstellungsbedingungen auf Basis eines GAV

• Lohngleichheit zwischen Mann und Frau

• Treueprämien

• 16 Wochen Mutterschaftsurlaub bei vollem Lohn

• 2 Wochen Vaterschaftsurlaub

• Finanzielle Beiträge zur Kinderbetreuung

• Umfassendes Angebot an internen und externen Weiterbildungen

Fragen?

Mandy Hoffmann
Bereichsleitung Kognition und Verhalten HPSZ Solothurn
032 627 92 23

Mit Engagement bewegen. – Das ist die Chance, in einer sinnstiftenden Tätigkeit von politischer und gesellschaftlicher Relevanz, Verantwortung zu tragen und mit dem eigenen Abdruck nachhaltige Entwicklungen für Bevölkerung und Wirtschaft zu bewegen. Hinter diesem Versprechen steht der Kanton Solothurn mit unzähligen Möglichkeiten, einer erlebbaren Flexibilität und einer Stabilität im Arbeitsumfeld.

Überzeugt?

Diese Stelle möchten wir ohne Unterstützung von externen Dienstleistern besetzen. E-Mail-Bewerbungen können nicht berücksichtigt werden.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Designazione delle merci

Il Heilpädagogische Schulzentrum (HPSZ): Una scuola - quattro sedi. Insegniamo e promuoviamo i nostri studenti dall'età dell'asilo alla scuola lasciando olisticamente e individualmente. La nostra offerta educativa diversificata consente una buona scuola, sviluppo sociale e personale. Per HPSZ Soletta cerchiamo un insegnante primario o un insegnante di cura, 83%, per un periodo limitato fino al 31.07.2028.

La vostra responsabilità

- Come insegnante qualificato, accompagnerai i nostri studenti nel ciclo 1 nell'offerta speciale del VK, che ha un requisito di finanziamento speciale. - Sei responsabile dell'insegnamento, della pianificazione dei finanziamenti, nonché del lavoro organizzativo e amministrativo in relazione alla gestione della classe. - Il team di classe sotto la tua guida è costituito da personale pedagogico e da uno stagista. - Lavori in stretta collaborazione con genitori, uffici specializzati, terapisti, altre istituzioni e la direzione della scuola.

- Contiamo sulla vostra collaborazione nei progetti di sviluppo scolastico.

Il tuo profilo

- Nella scuola speciale hai già esperienza o sei disposto ad impegnarsi in bambini con esigenze particolari. - Il sostegno individuale dei nostri studenti non è solo una professione, ma una vocazione per te. - Nell'affrontare i bambini e i loro genitori sei paziente, chiaro e riconoscente; un senso dell'umorismo completa il tuo profilo.

- Come persona creativa e entusiasta, apprezzi il lavoro interdisciplinare e sei felice di contribuire all'ulteriore sviluppo della scuola. - Promuovere l'equilibrio personale tra vita professionale e vita lavorativa attraverso un modello annuale di orario di lavoro - Lavoro a tempo parziale, anche nel quadro - La quota di lavoro mobile - Condizioni di lavoro avanzate basate su un GAV - Parità di retribuzione tra uomo e donna - Premi di fedeltà - Congedo di maternità di 16 settimane con piena retribuzione - Congedo di paternità di 2 settimane - Contributi finanziari all'infanzia - Gamma completa di formazione interna ed esterna

Domande?

Mandy Hoffmann Capo della K-Cognition e Behavior HPSZ Soletta 032 627 92 23

Convinto?

Vorremmo riempire questa posizione senza il supporto di fornitori di servizi esterni. Le applicazioni email non possono essere prese in considerazione.

Offriamo

- promozione dell'equilibrio tra vita professionale e vita privata mediante un modello annuale di orario di lavoro - lavoro a tempo parziale, anche nel quadro - possibilità di lavoro mobile - condizioni di lavoro progressive basate su un GAV - parità di retribuzione tra uomini e donne - premi fedeltà - congedo di maternità di 16 settimane con retribuzione piena - congedo di paternità di 2 settimane - contributi finanziari all'assistenza all'infanzia - offerta completa di formazione interna ed esterna
descriptionByLocale.en:
Description

The Heilpädagogische Schulzentrum (HPSZ): One school - four locations. We teach and promote our students from kindergarten age to school leaving holistically and individually. Our diverse educational offer enables good school, social and personal development. For HPSZ Solothurn we are looking for a primary teacher or curative teacher, 83%, for a limited period of time until 31.07.2028.

Your Responsibility

- As a trained teacher, you will accompany our students in cycle 1 in the cantonal special offer of the VK, which has a special funding requirement. - You are responsible for the teaching, funding planning, as well as organizational and administrative work in connection with the class management. - The class team under your leadership consists of pedagogical staff and an intern. - You work closely together with parents, specialist offices, therapists, other institutions and the school management.

- We count on your cooperation in school development projects.

Your profile

- You may have a basic pedagogical (primary) education with additional curative education. - In special school you already have experience or are willing to engage in children with special needs. - The individual support of our students is not only a profession but a vocation for you. - In dealing with children and their parents you are patient, clear and appreciative; a sense of humor completes your profile.

- As a creative, enthusiastic person you value interdisciplinary teamwork and are happy to contribute to the further development of the school. - Promote personal work-life balance through an annual working time model - Part-time work, also in the cadre - Possibility of mobile work - Advanced employment conditions based on a GAV - Equal pay between man and woman - Loyalty premiums - 16 weeks maternity leave with full pay - 2 weeks paternity leave - Financial contributions to childcare - Comprehensive range of internal and external training

Questions?

Mandy Hoffmann Head of K-Cognition and Behavior HPSZ Solothurn 032 627 92 23

Convinced?

We would like to fill this position without the support of external service providers. Email applications cannot be considered.

We offer

- promotion of personal work-life balance through an annual working time model - part-time work, also in the cadre - possibility of mobile work - progressive employment conditions based on a GAV - equal pay between men and women - loyalty premiums - 16 weeks maternity leave with full pay - 2 weeks paternity leave - financial contributions to childcare - comprehensive offer of internal and external training

Désignation des marchandises

Nous enseignons et faisons la promotion de nos élèves de l'âge de la maternelle à l'école en quittant l'école de façon holistique et individuelle. Notre offre éducative diversifiée permet un bon développement scolaire, social et personnel. Pour HPSZ Soleure, nous cherchons un enseignant primaire ou curatif, 83%, pour une période limitée jusqu'au 31.07.2028.

Votre responsabilité

- En tant qu'enseignant qualifié, vous accompagnerez nos élèves dans le cycle 1 de l'offre spéciale cantonale du VK, qui a un besoin de financement spécial. - Vous êtes responsable de l'enseignement, de la planification financière, ainsi que des travaux d'organisation et d'administration en lien avec la gestion de classe. - L'équipe de classe sous votre direction est composée de personnel pédagogique et d'un stagiaire. - Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les parents, les bureaux spécialisés, les thérapeutes, d'autres institutions et la direction de l'école.

- Nous comptons sur votre coopération dans les projets de développement scolaire.

Votre profil

- Vous pouvez avoir une éducation pédagogique (primaire) de base avec une éducation curative supplémentaire. - Dans une école spéciale, vous avez déjà de l'expérience ou êtes prêt à vous engager dans des enfants ayant des besoins spéciaux. - Le soutien individuel de nos élèves n'est pas seulement une profession mais une vocation pour vous. - En traitant avec les enfants et leurs parents, vous êtes patient, clair et reconnaissant; un sens de l'humour complète votre profil.

- En tant que personne créative et enthousiaste, vous appréciez le travail d'équipe interdisciplinaire et êtes heureux de contribuer au développement de l'école. - Promouvoir l'équilibre personnel entre le travail et la vie personnelle par un modèle annuel de temps de travail - Travail à temps partiel, également dans le cadre - Possibilité de travail mobile - Conditions d'emploi avancées basées sur un VAB - Égalité de rémunération entre homme et femme - Primes de fidélité - 16 semaines de congé de maternité à plein salaire - 2 semaines de congé de paternité - Contributions financières aux soins de santé - Gamme complète de formation interne et externe

Des questions?

Mandy Hoffmann Chef de K-Cognition et Behavior HPSZ Soleure 032 627 92 23

Convaincu?

Nous aimerions combler ce poste sans le soutien de fournisseurs de services externes. Les demandes de courriel ne peuvent pas être prises en considération.

Nous offrons

- promotion de l'équilibre personnel entre vie professionnelle et vie privée par un modèle annuel de temps de travail - travail à temps partiel, également dans le cadre - possibilité de travail mobile - conditions d'emploi progressives fondées sur un VAB - salaire égal entre les hommes et les femmes - primes de fidélité - 16 semaines de congé de maternité à plein salaire - 2 semaines de congé de paternité - contributions financières aux soins aux enfants - offre globale de formation interne et externe

jobs.title: ICT-Security Spezialist/-in, 80-100%
jobs.description:
Das Amt für Informatik und Organisation (AIO) ist das Kompetenzzentrum für Digitalisierung und Technologie im Kanton Solothurn. Es setzt Informatikprojekte um, berät und unterstützt die Departemente und sorgt für den Betrieb sowie Unterhalt der zentralen IT- und Kommunikationssysteme. Für die Abteilung Management Systeme/GRC suchen wir per 01.07.2026 oder nach Vereinbarung am Standort Solothurn eine/-n ICT-Security Spezialist/-in, 80-100%.

Ihre Verantwortung

• In dieser zentralen Funktion prägen Sie die Informationssicherheit unseres Kantons aktiv mit und entwickeln das kantonale Informationssicherheitsmanagementsystems (ISMS) nach ISO 27001 kontinuierlich weiter.

• Sie überwachen die IT-Sicherheit im Security Operations-Bereich, steuern das Incident Management bei Sicherheitsvorfällen und begleiten kantonale IT-Projekte sowie Fachgremien mit Ihrer Expertise.

• In Ihren Verantwortungsbereich fallen zudem die laufende Beurteilung von Bedrohungen, das Einleiten effektiver Schutzmassnahmen sowie das Erstellen von ICT-Sicherheitsspezifikationen, Zielen und Richtlinien. Hierzu überprüfen Sie die Wirksamkeit aller Vorkehrungen und beobachten die technologische Entwicklung im Bereich der ICT-Sicherheit fortlaufend.

Ihr Profil

• Sie bringen eine fundierte höhere Berufsbildung mit, idealerweise als eidgenössisch diplomierte/-r ICT Security Expert oder mit einem MAS/CAS in Information Security. Ein Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder Cyber Security (ETH, Uni, FH) ist von Vorteil.

• Mit Ihrer mindestens 5- bis 7-jährigen fundierten Praxis in der IT-Sicherheit und einer Zertifizierung als CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional) bringen Sie das ideale Fundament für diese Rolle mit. Ergänzende Qualifikationen wie ein CCSP, herstellerspezifische Cloud-Sicherheitszertifikate (z. B. Azure Security) oder ein CEH (Certified Ethical Hacker) runden Ihr Profil optimal ab.

• Zudem kommunizieren Sie im beruflichen Alltag verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch und Englisch.

• Förderung der persönlichen Work-Life-Balance durch ein Jahresarbeitszeitmodell

• Teilzeitarbeit, auch im Kader

• Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten

• Fortschrittliche Anstellungsbedingungen auf Basis eines GAV

• Lohngleichheit zwischen Mann und Frau

• Treueprämien

• 16 Wochen Mutterschaftsurlaub bei vollem Lohn

• 2 Wochen Vaterschaftsurlaub

• Finanzielle Beiträge zur Kinderbetreuung

• Umfassendes Angebot an internen und externen Weiterbildungen

descriptionByLocale.it:
Designazione delle merci

L'Ufficio per l'Informatica e l'Organizzazione (AIO) è il centro di competenza per la digitalizzazione e la tecnologia nel cantone di Soletta. Implementa progetti informatici, consiglia e supporta i dipartimenti e garantisce il funzionamento e la manutenzione dei sistemi centrali di IT e comunicazione. Stiamo cercando il dipartimento Sistemi di Gestione/GRC il 01.07.026 o previo accordo presso la sede Solothurn uno specialista di sicurezza ICT, 80-100%.

La vostra responsabilità

- In questa funzione centrale, si modella attivamente la sicurezza delle informazioni del nostro cantone e si sviluppa continuamente il sistema di gestione della sicurezza informatica (ISMS) a base di ISO 27001. - Si monitora la sicurezza informatica nell'area operativa di sicurezza, si controlla la gestione degli incidenti in caso di incidenti di sicurezza e si accompagnano con la propria competenza progetti IT a base di 339nale e organismi professionali.

- La vostra responsabilità comprende anche la valutazione in corso delle minacce, l'introduzione di misure di protezione efficaci e la creazione di specifiche, obiettivi e linee guida di sicurezza delle TIC. Per farlo, controllare l'efficacia di tutte le precauzioni e monitorare lo sviluppo tecnologico nel campo della sicurezza delle TIC in modo continuo.

Il tuo profilo

- Portate con voi un'istruzione professionale sana superiore, idealmente come un diploma eidgenössisch /-r ICT Security Expert o con un MAS/CAS in sicurezza dell'informazione. Un laurea o un master in informatica, informatica aziendale o sicurezza informatica (ETH, Uni, FH) è un vantaggio. - Con la vostra pratica audio di almeno 5 a 7 anni in sicurezza informatica e una certificazione come un CISP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional) si porta la base ideale per questo ruolo.

Qualifiche complementari come un CCSP, certificati di sicurezza cloud specifici per i fornitori (ad esempio Azure Security) o un CEH (Certified Ethical Hacker) completano il tuo profilo in modo ottimale. - Inoltre, si comunica in tedesco e inglese nella vita professionale quotidiana.

- promozione dell'equilibrio tra vita professionale e vita privata mediante un modello annuale di orario di lavoro - lavoro a tempo parziale, anche nel quadro - possibilità di lavoro mobile - condizioni di lavoro progressive basate su un GAV - parità di retribuzione tra uomini e donne - premi fedeltà - congedo di maternità di 16 settimane con retribuzione piena - congedo di paternità di 2 settimane - contributi finanziari all'assistenza all'infanzia - offerta completa di formazione interna ed esterna

Contatto

Domande?

M. Grunewald Responsabile dei sistemi di gestione / GRC 032 627 23 30

Convinto?

Vorremmo riempire questa posizione senza il supporto di fornitori di servizi esterni. Le applicazioni email non possono essere prese in considerazione.

Muovendosi con impegno... Questa è l'occasione per assumersi la responsabilità di un'attività sinnfähtigende di rilevanza politica e sociale e per muovere con la propria impronta gli sviluppi sostenibili per la popolazione e l'economia. Dietro questa promessa si trova il Cantone di Soletta con innumerevoli possibilità, una flessibilità esperienzabile e una stabilità nell'ambiente di lavoro.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Description

The Office for Informatics and Organisation (AIO) is the competence center for digitisation and technology in the canton of Solothurn. It implements computer science projects, advises and supports the departments and ensures the operation and maintenance of the central IT and communication systems. We are looking for the department Management Systems/GRC on 01.07.2026 or by agreement at the location Solothurn an ICT security specialist, 80-100%.

Your Responsibility

- In this central function, you actively shape the information security of our canton and continuously develop the cantonal information security management system (ISMS) according to ISO 27001. - You monitor IT security in the security operations area, control incident management in case of security incidents and accompany cantonal IT projects and professional bodies with your expertise.

- Your responsibility also includes the ongoing assessment of threats, the introduction of effective protection measures, and the creation of ICT security specifications, objectives and guidelines. To do so, check the effectiveness of all precautions and monitor the technological development in the field of ICT security continuously.

Your profile

- You bring a sound higher vocational education with you, ideally as an eidgenössisch diploma /-r ICT Security Expert or with a MAS/CAS in Information Security. A Bachelor or Master degree in Informatics, Business Informatics or Cyber Security (ETH, Uni, FH) is an advantage. - With your at least 5 to 7-year-old sound practice in IT security and a certification as a CISP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional) you bring the ideal foundation for this role.

Complementary qualifications such as a CCSP, vendor-specific cloud security certificates (e.g. Azure Security) or a CEH (Certified Ethical Hacker) round off your profile optimally. - In addition, you communicate in German and English in everyday professional life.

- promotion of personal work-life balance through an annual working time model - part-time work, also in the cadre - possibility of mobile work - progressive employment conditions based on a GAV - equal pay between men and women - loyalty premiums - 16 weeks maternity leave with full pay - 2 weeks paternity leave - financial contributions to childcare - comprehensive offer of internal and external training

Contact

Questions?

Ms. M. Grunewald Head of Management Systems / GRC 032 627 23 30

Convinced?

We would like to fill this position without the support of external service providers. Email applications cannot be considered.

Moving with commitment. – This is the chance to bear responsibility in a sinnfähtigende activity of political and social relevance and to move sustainable developments for the population and the economy with its own imprint. Behind this promise stands the Canton of Solothurn with countless possibilities, an experienceable flexibility and a stability in the working environment.

Votre responsabilité

- Dans cette fonction centrale, vous façonnez activement la sécurité de l'information de notre canton et développez en permanence le système cantonal de gestion de la sécurité de l'information (ISMS) selon ISO 27001. - Vous surveillez la sécurité informatique dans la zone des opérations de sécurité, contrôlez la gestion des incidents en cas d'incidents de sécurité et accompagnez les projets cantonaux de TI et les organismes professionnels avec votre expertise.

Description

The seven offices of the canton of Solothurn are the regional contact points for a wide range of public services: They combine the functions of a notary, the land registry, inheritance, office of recovery and bankruptcy as well as the commercial registry office and are therefore available to private individuals, companies and authorities as competent contact persons. We are looking for a director of office writing at the location Solothurn on 01.01.2027 or by agreement at the location Solothurn, 80-100%.

Your Responsibility

- As a newly created office in the financial department, develop and build up the new management structures. - They run the office writing companies, a decentralised organization with over 200 employees at seven locations, effectively and coordinated in a professional, financial, personnel and organizational way. - With a customer-friendly and service-oriented appearance of the office writing agencies you achieve a high level of location attractiveness.

- You ensure uniform application of law across all locations as well as the correct technical performance of tasks in the areas of notaryship, land register, inheritance office, commercial register office and the Office of Execution and Bankruptcy. - You actively shape the digital transformation and bring forward the further development of our processes and instruments.

Your profile

- You have acquired your professional equipment with the notarial patent in Solothurn or with a legal university degree preferably with notarial and/or lawyer's patent. - You are a personality with several years of professional experience in one or more departments of the office writings. - In addition to good communication and editorial skills you have a strong negotiating skill and assertive capacity. - You have ideally already gained leadership experience in a large decentralized organized authority or a company.

- With your customer-oriented appearance as well as a high level of leadership and social competence, you can also move and network well in the political environment.

We offer

- promotion of personal work-life balance through an annual working time model - part-time work, also in the cadre - possibility of mobile work - progressive employment conditions based on a GAV - equal pay between men and women - loyalty premiums - 16 weeks maternity leave with full pay - 2 weeks paternity leave - financial contributions to childcare - comprehensive offer of internal and external training

Contact

Questions?

Jürg Studer Secretary of State for Finance 032 627 20 58

Convinced?

descriptionByLocale.en:
The Office for Economic Affairs and Labour of the Canton of Solothurn is a dynamic organization that provides public services in various departments: among others regional employment agencies RAV, public unemployment fund, working conditions and energy and climate. For the public unemployment fund of the Canton of Solothurn, we are looking for a job-employed person in the Solothurn office for a period of two years, per immediate or by appointment, for a period of two years, 80-100%.

• You are self-employed in processing applications for unemployment benefits and are examining the entitlement.

L'Ufficio Migrazioni è responsabile delle questioni di diritto straniero e d'asilo nel cantone di Soletta e dei documenti d'identificazione dei cittadini svizzeri. Cerchiamo l'ingresso e la residenza nel dipartimento d'ingresso e di soggiorno immediatamente o su appuntamento presso la sede di Soletta, 80-100%.

La vostra responsabilità

- Assumete la responsabilità generale del Dipartimento "Entrazione e soggiorno," composto dai tre dipartimenti "Migrazione familiare e visti," "Altri ingressi e occupazione" e "Aufenthalt" con un totale di 23 dipendenti. - Ciò comprende oltre alla gestione del personale, la gestione e l'ulteriore sviluppo dei processi di processo, la responsabilità professionale, finanziaria e politica per il dipartimento e i suoi indicatori. - Nella vostra funzione dirigete il dipartimento "Migrazione familiare e visti." descriptionByLocale.en:
Description

The Migration Office is responsible for foreign and asylum law matters in the canton of Solothurn as well as for identification documents of Swiss nationals. We are looking for entry and residence in the department of entry and residence by immediately or by appointment at the location of Solothurn, 80-100%.

Your Responsibility

- You assume the overall responsibility of the Department "Entry and Stay", consisting of the three departments "Family Migration and Visa", "Other Entry and Employment" and "Aufenthalt" with a total of 23 employees. - This includes besides the personnel management, the management and further development of the process processes, the professional, financial and political responsibility for the department and its indicators. - In your function you direct the department "Family Migration and Visa". The motivated team consists of 6 specialists.

The other two departments lead you through two department heads. - They ensure that legal hearings and complex orders are edited in compliance with the law. To do this, you may conduct extensive factual clarifications with other authorities, institutions or via embassies abroad, conduct interviews and write demanding correspondence if necessary. Furthermore, the Office's representation in court or the writing of consultation to the courts is part of your field of responsibility.

- Monitoring and understanding the legal development in migration law, the other national law and international law (teaching, case law, political development, practice) are just as important to your tasks as answering internal and external inquiries in compliance with data protection legislation. In addition, the versatile field of responsibility includes the drafting of opinions and co-reports as well as the management of department-relevant statistics.

Your profile

- You have a legal training (lic. iur./Master) with several years of management experience; the attorney's patent is advantageous. - You also have professional experience in the field of migration law or in the public administration. - You are ready to assume a high degree of responsibility. You are very resilient, able to team and are characterized by an exact, independent and service-oriented working method with the necessary sense for social political contexts.

- You have a high level of social competence and a strong communication ability. - Careful work, networked and solution-oriented thinking and the ability to handle time pressure are the distinguishing features of your profile. - Your profile is rounded off by strong editorial skills, language skills (second language and English) and comprehensive digital skills (office, CMI, various federal applications).

- promotion of personal work-life balance through an annual working time model - part-time work, also in the cadre - possibility of mobile work - progressive employment conditions based on a GAV - equal pay between men and women - loyalty premiums - 16 weeks maternity leave with full pay - 2 weeks paternity leave - financial contributions to childcare - comprehensive offer of internal and external training

Contact

Questions?

Rachel Linz Head of Office 032 627 63 24

We move

Moving with commitment. – This is the chance to bear responsibility in a sinnfähigend activity of political and social relevance and to move sustainable developments for the population and the economy with its own imprint. Behind this promise stands the Canton of Solothurn with countless possibilities, an experienceable flexibility and a stability in the working environment.

Convinced?

We would like to fill this position without the support of external service providers. Email applications cannot be considered.

jobs.description:
Die Personal- und Organisationsentwicklung leistet einen wichtigen Beitrag zur nachhaltigen Weiterentwicklung der Polizei Kanton Solothurn. Für die Abteilung Kommandostab suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung am Standort Solothurn eine/-n Fachspezialist/-in Personalauswahl, 80-100%.

Ihre Verantwortung

• Sie verantworten die ganzheitliche Planung, Organisation, Koordination und Begleitung für Auswahlverfahren (Reisetätigkeit im gesamten Kantonsgebiet). Dabei sichern sowie entwickeln Sie die Qualität der Personalauswahl, insbesondere für interne Laufbahn- und Kaderselektionen.

• Sie bringen Ihre psychologische Expertise bei der Beurteilung von Potenzialen, Eignungen und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten ein.

• Die Konzeption, Koordination und Evaluation von eignungsdiagnostischen Verfahren und psychologischen Testungen liegt in Ihrer Verantwortung.

• Als zentrale Ansprechperson beraten und unterstützen Sie Linienverantwortliche in personalauswahlrelevanten sowie eignungsdiagnostischen Fragestellungen.

• Sie wirken bei Projekten der Personal- und Organisationsentwicklung mit und gestalten HR-Prozesse aktiv weiter.

Ihr Profil

• Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Bachelorstudium der Psychologie.

• Sie bringen mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich der Arbeits- und Organisationspsychologie sowie fundierte Kenntnisse in der Personalauswahl, Eignungsdiagnostik und Durchführung von Assessments mit.

• Idealerweise konnten Sie bereits praktische Erfahrungen in der Projektarbeit sammeln und verfügen über ein Grundverständnis von HR-Prozessen sowie der Organisationsentwicklung. Die Bereitschaft, sich in diesen Bereichen kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln, rundet Ihr Profil ab.

• Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Vernetzungsfähigkeiten, eine sehr selbstständige Arbeitsweise sowie ein ausgewogenes Selbstbewusstsein zeichnen Sie aus.

• Dank Ihres souveränen Auftretens und Ihres Handlungsgeschicks gelingt es Ihnen, die unterschiedlichen Bedürfnisse und Interessen verschiedener Anspruchsgruppen ausgewogen zu berücksichtigen.

• Förderung der persönlichen Work-Life-Balance durch ein Jahresarbeitszeitmodell

• Teilzeitarbeit, auch im Kader

• Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten

• Fortschrittliche Anstellungsbedingungen auf Basis eines GAV

• Lohngleichheit zwischen Mann und Frau

• Treueprämien

• 16 Wochen Mutterschaftsurlaub bei vollem Lohn

• 2 Wochen Vaterschaftsurlaub

• Finanzielle Beiträge zur Kinderbetreuung

• Umfassendes Angebot an internen und externen Weiterbildungen

Fragen?

Nicole Simon
Leiterin Personal- und Organisationsentwicklung
032 627 87 15

Mit Engagement bewegen. – Das ist die Chance, in einer sinnstiftenden Tätigkeit von politischer und gesellschaftlicher Relevanz, Verantwortung zu tragen und mit dem eigenen Abdruck nachhaltige Entwicklungen für Bevölkerung und Wirtschaft zu bewegen. Hinter diesem Versprechen steht der Kanton Solothurn mit unzähligen Möglichkeiten, einer erlebbaren Flexibilität und einer Stabilität im Arbeitsumfeld.

Überzeugt?

Diese Stelle möchten wir ohne Unterstützung von externen Dienstleistern besetzen. E-Mail-Bewerbungen können nicht berücksichtigt werden.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Designazione delle merci

Lo sviluppo del personale e dell'organizzazione contribuisce in modo significativo allo sviluppo sostenibile del cantone di polizia di Soletta. Per il personale di comando del dipartimento, cerchiamo un esperto/specialista/in selezione del personale, 80-100%, immediatamente o su appuntamento presso la sede di Soletta.

La vostra responsabilità

- Lei è responsabile della pianificazione olistica, dell'organizzazione, del coordinamento e del monitoraggio delle procedure di selezione (attività di viaggio in tutta l'area del numero di abitanti del settore); Lei assicura e sviluppa la qualità della selezione del personale, in particolare per le selezioni interne di carriera e quadri. - Lei contribuisce alla sua esperienza psicologica nella valutazione di potenziali, attitudini e opportunità di sviluppo. - La concezione, il coordinamento e la valutazione delle procedure diagnostiche di idoneità e dei test psicologici è responsabilità sua.

- Come persona di contatto centrale, consigliate e supportate i responsabili delle linee di selezione personale e dei problemi diagnostici di idoneità. - Partecipate ai progetti di sviluppo del personale e organizzativo e formate attivamente i processi HR.

Il tuo profilo

- Hai una laurea in psicologia completa. - Hai diversi anni di esperienza professionale nel campo del lavoro e della psicologia organizzativa, nonché una profonda conoscenza della selezione del personale, diagnostica delle attitudini e implementazione del corso del corso del corso. - Idealmente, hai già acquisito esperienza pratica nel lavoro di progetto e avere una comprensione di base dei processi HR e sviluppo organizzativo. La volontà di sviluppare continuamente in queste aree completa il tuo profilo.

- Si distingue per le caratteristiche capacità di comunicazione e di rete, un metodo di lavoro molto indipendente e una fiducia in se stessi equilibrata. - Grazie al suo aspetto sovrano e alle sue capacità di azione, riesce a tenere conto delle diverse esigenze e interessi dei diversi stakeholder.

- promozione dell'equilibrio tra vita professionale e vita privata mediante un modello annuale di orario di lavoro - lavoro a tempo parziale, anche nel quadro - possibilità di lavoro mobile - condizioni di lavoro progressive basate su un GAV - parità di retribuzione tra uomini e donne - premi fedeltà - congedo di maternità di 16 settimane con retribuzione piena - congedo di paternità di 2 settimane - contributi finanziari all'assistenza all'infanzia - offerta completa di formazione interna ed esterna

Contatto

Domande?

Nicole Simon Capo delle Risorse Umane e dello Sviluppo Organizzativo 032 627 87 15

Convinto?

Vorremmo riempire questa posizione senza il supporto di fornitori di servizi esterni. Le applicazioni email non possono essere prese in considerazione.

Ci muoviamo

Questa è l'occasione per assumersi la responsabilità di un'attività di sinnfähigend di rilevanza politica e sociale e per muovere con la propria impronta sviluppi sostenibili per la popolazione e l'economia. Dietro questa promessa si trova il Cantone di Soletta con innumerevoli possibilità, una flessibilità esperta e una stabilità nell'ambiente di lavoro.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Description

The development of personnel and organisation makes an important contribution to the sustainable development of the police canton Solothurn. For the department command staff we are looking for an expert/specialist/in personnel selection, 80-100%, by immediately or by appointment at the location Solothurn.

Your Responsibility

- You are responsible for the holistic planning, organization, coordination and monitoring of selection procedures (travel activities throughout the cantonal area). You ensure and develop the quality of the personnel selection, especially for internal career and cadre selections. - You contribute your psychological expertise in assessing potentials, aptitudes and development opportunities. - The conception, coordination and evaluation of suitability diagnostic procedures and psychological testing is your responsibility.

- As a central contact person, you advise and support line managers in personal selection and suitability diagnostics issues. - You participate in projects of personnel and organizational development and actively shape HR processes.

Your profile

- You have a completed bachelor's degree in psychology. - You have several years of professional experience in the field of work and organizational psychology as well as a profound knowledge of personnel selection, aptitude diagnostics and implementation of the course of the course of the course of the course. - Ideally, you have already gained practical experience in project work and have a basic understanding of HR processes and organizational development. The willingness to develop continuously in these areas rounds off your profile.

- You are distinguished by the distinctive communication and networking capabilities, a very independent working method and a balanced self-confidence. - Thanks to your sovereign appearance and your action skills, you manage to take into account the different needs and interests of different stakeholders.

- promotion of personal work-life balance through an annual working time model - part-time work, also in the cadre - possibility of mobile work - progressive employment conditions based on a GAV - equal pay between men and women - loyalty premiums - 16 weeks maternity leave with full pay - 2 weeks paternity leave - financial contributions to childcare - comprehensive offer of internal and external training

Contact

Questions?

Nicole Simon Head of Human Resources and Organizational Development 032 627 87 15

Convinced?

We would like to fill this position without the support of external service providers. Email applications cannot be considered.

We move

Moving with commitment. – This is the chance to bear responsibility in a sinnfähigend activity of political and social relevance and to move sustainable developments for the population and the economy with its own imprint. Behind this promise stands the Canton of Solothurn with countless possibilities, an experienceable flexibility and a stability in the working environment.

Désignation des marchandises

Le développement du personnel et de l'organisation contribue de façon importante au développement durable du canton de police Soleure. Pour le personnel de commandement du département, nous recherchons un expert/spécialiste/dans la sélection du personnel, 80-100%, sur rendez-vous immédiat ou sur rendez-vous à l'emplacement Soleure.

Votre responsabilité

- Vous êtes responsable de la planification, de l'organisation, de la coordination et du suivi des procédures de sélection (activités de voyage dans toute la zone cantonale) ; vous assurez et développez la qualité de la sélection du personnel, notamment pour les carrières internes et les sélections des cadres. - Vous contribuez à l'évaluation des potentiels, des possibilités de perfectionnement et de la représentativité ; - La conception, la coordination et l'évaluation des procédures de diagnostic et des tests psychologiques sont de votre ressort.

- En tant que personne-ressource centrale, vous conseillez et aidez les gestionnaires hiérarchiques dans les questions de sélection personnelle et de diagnostic des qualités. - Vous participez à des projets de développement du personnel et de l'organisation et façonnez activement les processus des RH.

Votre profil

- Vous avez obtenu un baccalauréat en psychologie. - Vous avez plusieurs années d'expérience professionnelle dans le domaine du travail et de la psychologie organisationnelle ainsi qu'une connaissance approfondie de la sélection du personnel, des diagnostics d'aptitudes et de la mise en oeuvre du cours du cours. - Idéalement, vous avez déjà acquis une expérience pratique dans le travail de projet et une compréhension de base des processus de RH et du développement organisationnel.

- Vous vous distinguez par les capacités de communication et de réseautage, une méthode de travail très indépendante et une confiance en soi équilibrée. - Grâce à votre apparence souveraine et vos compétences en action, vous réussissez à prendre en compte les différents besoins et intérêts des différents acteurs.

- promotion de l'équilibre personnel entre vie professionnelle et vie privée par un modèle annuel de temps de travail - travail à temps partiel, également dans le cadre - possibilité de travail mobile - conditions d'emploi progressives fondées sur un VAB - salaire égal entre les hommes et les femmes - primes de fidélité - 16 semaines de congé de maternité à plein salaire - 2 semaines de congé de paternité - contributions financières aux soins aux enfants - offre globale de formation interne et externe

Personne à contacter

Des questions?

Nicole Simon Chef des Ressources humaines et du Développement organisationnel 032 627 87 15

Convaincu?

Nous aimerions combler ce poste sans le soutien de fournisseurs de services externes. Les demandes de courriel ne peuvent pas être prises en considération.

Nous bougeons

C'est l'occasion de porter la responsabilité dans une activité sinnfähigend d'importance politique et sociale et de faire évoluer les développements durables pour la population et l'économie avec sa propre empreinte. Derrière cette promesse se trouve le canton de Soleure avec d'innombrables possibilités, une flexibilité experiencenable et une stabilité dans l'environnement de travail.

• Sie beraten Landwirtinnen und Landwirte bei der Umstellung des Betriebes auf biologische Produktion.

• Praxisorientierte Anlässe in der Erwachsenenbildung sowie Informationsveranstaltungen werden von Ihnen durchgeführt.

Description

The Wallierhof Education Centre is the centre of competence for domestic and agricultural training, further education and consulting in the canton of Solothurn. We are looking for a consultant and specialist teacher in organic plant production on 01.08.2026 or by appointment at the Riedholz site, 40-50%.

Your Responsibility

- You advise farmers on the conversion of the farm to organic production. - Your responsibility includes advising farmers in the field of organic plant production. - Practical events in adult education and information events are carried out by you. - You teach plant-based topics in basic and continuing vocational training.

Your profile

- You have a degree in agronomist, MSc or equivalent education and ideally have a didactic certificate. - Your high level of expertise in organic plant cultivation and preferably experience in consulting and teaching are the distinguishing features of you. You are looking for a very interesting, varied and practical activity with a high degree of responsibility. - Your strengths include resilience, high flexibility and initiative, and joy in working with different stakeholders.

- You want to test and implement innovative approaches for sustainable agriculture and to contribute and develop your experience in a small, motivated team.

- promotion of personal work-life balance through an annual working time model - part-time work, also in the cadre - possibility of mobile work - progressive employment conditions based on a GAV - equal pay between men and women - loyalty premiums - 16 weeks maternity leave with full pay - 2 weeks paternity leave - financial contributions to childcare - comprehensive offer of internal and external training

Désignation des marchandises

Le Wallierhof Education Centre est le centre de compétence pour la formation domestique et agricole, la formation continue et le conseil dans le canton de Soleure. Nous recherchons un consultant et un professeur spécialisé dans la production biologique des plantes au 01.08.2026 ou sur rendez-vous sur le site de Riedholz, 40-50%.

Votre responsabilité

- Vous conseillez les agriculteurs sur la conversion de la ferme en production biologique. - Votre responsabilité comprend la fourniture de conseils aux agriculteurs dans le domaine de la production biologique. - Des événements pratiques dans l'éducation des adultes et des événements d'information sont organisés par vous. - Vous enseignez des sujets végétaux dans la formation professionnelle de base et continue.

Die Motorfahrzeugkontrolle ist zuständig für die Zulassung von Personen und Strassenfahrzeugen sowie Schiffen zum Verkehr. Sie überprüft die Betriebssicherheit der im Verkehr stehenden oder neu zuzulassenden Strassenfahrzeuge und Schiffe anlässlich von technischen Kontrollen. Weiter führt die Motorfahrzeugkontrolle die theoretischen und praktischen Führerprüfungen durch und überwacht die Fahreignung der Verkehrsteilnehmenden indem sie diese beispielsweise verkehrsmedizinischen Kontrollen zuweist. Ausserdem vollzieht die Motorfahrzeugkontrolle das Administrativmassnahmenrecht des Bundes (Verwarnungen, Führerausweisentzüge, Fahrverbote, Verkehrsunterricht usw.) um. • Selbstständige Ausführung sämtlicher Unterhaltsreinigungsarbeiten in Büros, Sitzungszimmern, Verkehrsflächen, Sanitäranlagen sowie Küchenbereichen gemäss Reinigungskonzept gehört zu Ihren Aufgaben.

• Nach Arbeitsplanung führen Sie periodische Fenster- und Spezialreinigungen durch.

• Die Reinigung und Pflege von Aussenbereichen sowie fachgerechte Entsorgung von Kehricht, Altpapier und Grüngut führen Sie durch.

• Sie sind zuständig für die Meldung von Mängeln sowie Bestellung und Bewirtschaftung von Reinigungs- und Verbrauchsmaterialien.

• Zudem achten Sie auch die Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Hygiene-, Sicherheits-, Gesundheits- und Umweltschutzvorschriften sowie Unterstützung bei weiteren betrieblichen Aufgaben.

Ihr Profil

• Erfahrung in der Unterhaltsreinigung oder in einer vergleichbaren Tätigkeit ist von Vorteil.

• Sie zeichnen sich durch eine selbstständige, zuverlässige wie auch sorgfältige Arbeitsweise mit ausgeprägtem Qualitätsbewusstsein aus.

• Flexibilität, Einsatzbereitschaft sowie Verantwortungsbewusstsein für die übertragenen Aufgaben ist für Sie selbstverständlich.

• Sie verfügen über gute Umgangsformen, gepflegtes Auftreten und diskreter Umgang mit Mitarbeitenden und Kundschaft. Zudem haben Sie Verständnis für Hygiene-, Sicherheits- und Reinigungsvorschriften sowie gute Deutschkenntnisse.

The regional police are keeping public safety high by daily local security, emergency intervention and traffic safety. It optimizes objective and subjective security by investigating the perpetrators for violations, offences or crimes. For the security department we are looking for a police assistant/s security assistant/s, 80-100%, on 01.02.2027 or by agreement for the Olten region.

Your Responsibility

- You are responsible for the safety and order of the Canton Solothurn. - You are engaged in a patrol activity in the canton of Solothurn in the form of a uniform and check the traffic in the canton of Solothurn, including the penalties for violations and traffic regulations. If necessary, you will carry out transports of prisoners, trace material, etc. throughout the canton. - You will provide enforcement support for other offices, especially for the Office of Execution.

La vostra responsabilità

- Come leader del team, sei responsabile del team Service Desk e del supporto con una chiara divisione dei compiti e un senso di priorità e ne promuovete l'ulteriore sviluppo. - Puoi garantire in modo affidabile il supporto sul posto di lavoro e l'intero ciclo di vita dei sistemi di lavoro per i dipendenti dell'amministrazione del numero di abitanti del tuo team in loco. - Progettate un modello di servizio tempestivo e trasversale - dal telefono all'e-mail al portale chat e self-service - e assicurate processi chiari e una base di dati sulla conoscenza ben tenuta.

Description The Office of Informatics and Organization AIO is the central ICT service provider of the Canton of Solothurn. We are developing our Service Desk and support team in a targeted manner - with a focus on digital customer contact, intelligent self-service offers and the gradual use of automation and AI. We are looking for a team leader/in service desk and support for the Technical Services department on 01.09.2026 or by agreement at the Solothurn site, 80-100%.

Your Responsibility

- As a team leader, you are responsible for the Service Desk team and support with a clear division of tasks and a sense of priorities and you promote their further development. - You can reliably ensure the workplace support and the entire lifecycle of workplace systems for employees of the cantonal administration with your team on site. - You design a timely, cross-channel service model - from telephone and email to chat and self-service portal - and ensure clear processes and a well-maintained knowledge database.

- You can continuously develop the service offered by Service Desk and Support - close to the clientele's needs and open to future expansions of the services. - You can identify where automation brings real added value, and you can also implement it (e.g. chatbots and AI-supported assistance systems for standard questions), evaluate new tools with a clear focus on efficiency and user-friendliness.

Your profile

- You have a completed ICT training, ideally with advanced training at the level of HF or FH - or comparable professional experience. - Perennial practice and leadership experience in ICT support or service management are of benefit. - Real interest in new technologies you are distinguished: you have already dealt with AI, chatbots and automation. - You have knowledge of ITSM processes - ITIL certification is a plus, but not a must. - You think structured, act pragmatically and do not lose sight of the user perspective.

We offer

- promotion of personal work-life balance through an annual working time model - part-time work, also in the cadre - possibility of mobile work - progressive employment conditions based on a GAV - equal pay between men and women - loyalty premiums - 16 weeks maternity leave with full pay - 2 weeks paternity leave - financial contributions to childcare - comprehensive offer of internal and external training

Contact

Daniel Moser Head of Technical Services 032 627 23 35

Moving with commitment. – This is the chance to bear responsibility in a sinnfähigend activity of political and social relevance and to move sustainable developments for the population and the economy with its own imprint. jobs.description:
Das Hochbauamt vertritt den Kanton als Grundeigentümer in sämtlichen Immobiliengeschäften und übernimmt die Bauherrenfunktion für kantonale Bauvorhaben. Die zuständigen Abteilungen Planen, Bauen und Bewirtschaften sind verantwortlich für die Planung, Realisierung von Neubauten, Umbauten und Sanierungen, für den Gebäudeunterhalt (Instandhaltung und Instandsetzung) sowie für den gesamten Gebäudebetrieb (technisches, infrastrukturelles, digitales und kaufmännisches Gebäudemanagement). Die Abteilung Planen verantwortet zudem die strategische Steuerung des Immobilienportfolios und entwickelt nachhaltige, wirtschaftliche und bedarfsgerechte Lösungen für die öffentliche Infrastruktur. Für die Abteilung Planen suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung befristet auf 2 Jahre am Standort Solothurn eine/-n Immobilienmanager/-in oder Immobilienentwickler/-in, 80-100%.

Ihre Verantwortung

• Auf Basis der Immobilienstrategie leiten Sie konkrete Massnahmen für Teilportfolios und einzelne Immobilien ab und sorgen für deren zielgerichtete und erfolgreiche Umsetzung.

• Sie bearbeiten Immobiliengeschäfte eigenverantwortlich und begleiten diese fachlich in miet-, sachenrechtlichen, wirtschaftlichen und strategischen Fragestellungen.

• In den SIA-Phasen 0 bis 3 (von der Initialisierung bis zur Projektierung bzw. zum Vorprojekt) unterstützen Sie unsere Projekte konzeptionell und inhaltlich und vertreten die Interessen des Kantons kompetent und überzeugend.

Ihr Profil

• Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Architektur (ETH/FH) oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung sowie über eine Weiterbildung im Immobilienbereich, bspw. MSc Business (mit Immobilienbezug), MAS Real Estate, MAS Real Estate Management, M.Sc. Real Estate.

• Langjährige Erfahrung im Immobilienmanagement und in der Immobilienentwicklung bringen Sie ebenso mit, wie Kenntnisse des öffentlichen Bau- und Planungswesens.

• Fundierte Kenntnisse im kaufmännischen Gebäudemanagement sowie im öffentlichen Beschaffungsrecht, Vertragsrecht, Sachenrecht und Mietrecht zeichnen Sie aus.

L'ufficio edilizio rappresenta il cantone come proprietario terriero in tutte le transazioni immobiliari e assume il ruolo di proprietario edilizio per progetti di costruzione cantonale. I dipartimenti responsabili Pianificazione, Costruzione e Gestione sono responsabili della progettazione, realizzazione di nuovi edifici, conversioni e ristrutturazioni, per la manutenzione degli edifici (manutenzione e riparazione) e per l'intera operazione di costruzione (gestione di edifici tecnici, infrastrutturali, digitali e commerciali). Il dipartimento di pianificazione è anche responsabile della gestione strategica del portafoglio immobiliare e sviluppa soluzioni sostenibili, economiche e basate sulle esigenze per le infrastrutture pubbliche. Per il dipartimento di pianificazione, stiamo cercando un responsabile immobiliare o sviluppatore immobiliare presso il sito Solothurn, 80-100%. La tua responsabilità
• Formano e controllano la strategia immobiliare del Cantone e sviluppano il portafoglio immobiliare cantonale in modo orientato alla domanda, orientato all'uso ed economicamente sostenibile.

Das Hochbauamt vertritt den Kanton als Grundeigentümer in sämtlichen Immobiliengeschäften und übernimmt die Bauherrenfunktion für kantonale Bauvorhaben. Die zuständigen Abteilungen Planen, Bauen und Bewirtschaften sind verantwortlich für die Planung, Realisierung von Neubauten, Umbauten und Sanierungen, für den Gebäudeunterhalt (Instandhaltung und Instandsetzung) sowie für den gesamten Gebäudebetrieb (technisches, infrastrukturelles, digitales und kaufmännisches Gebäudemanagement). • Auf Basis der Immobilienstrategie leiten Sie konkrete Massnahmen für Teilportfolios und einzelne Immobilien ab und sorgen für deren zielgerichtete und erfolgreiche Umsetzung.

• Sie bearbeiten Immobiliengeschäfte eigenverantwortlich und begleiten diese fachlich in miet-, sachenrechtlichen, wirtschaftlichen und strategischen Fragestellungen.

Designazione delle merci

Il Dipartimento di Caccia e Pesca dell'Ufficio Forestale, Caccia e Pesca è responsabile della conservazione e dell'uso sostenibile di mammiferi selvatici, uccelli e pesci, nonché dei loro habitat naturali. Stiamo cercando un responsabile co-dipartimentale per la caccia e la pesca nel sito di Solothurn di accordo immediato o su appuntamento, 60-70.

La vostra responsabilità

- Il dipartimento vi guiderà in una cogestione in termini professionali, personali, finanziari e organizzativi. - Vi siete impegnati a garantire che i mammiferi e gli uccelli così come i loro habitat siano protetti e che il loro uso sia sostenuto. - Con i vostri dipendenti siete responsabili dell'applicazione delle leggi di caccia del federale e cantone. - Per la politica del cantone fornite le necessarie informazioni strategiche e misure e concetti derivati.

- Essi forniscono la rappresentanza professionale verso gli utenti e i protettori, nonché verso le comunità all'interno del cantone e verso il governo federale.

Il tuo profilo

- Hai una laurea in biologia della fauna selvatica o relativa a specie e hai diversi anni di esperienza in un'occupazione simile, idealmente con esperienza di leadership. - Eccellente conoscenza del comportamento dei mammiferi e uccelli nativi e del loro uso sostenibile. - Hai eccellenti capacità comunicative, persuasivezza e assertività e sono una personalità resiliente e consensuale.

- Un alto livello di disponibilità a eseguire e una comprensione più profonda dei processi politici completano il vostro profilo. - Idealmente si dispone di un certificato di abilità di caccia e di esperienza di caccia pratica.

Offriamo

- promozione dell'equilibrio tra vita professionale e vita privata mediante un modello annuale di orario di lavoro - lavoro a tempo parziale, anche nel quadro - possibilità di lavoro mobile - condizioni di lavoro progressive basate su un GAV - parità di retribuzione tra uomini e donne - premi fedeltà - congedo di maternità di 16 settimane con retribuzione piena - congedo di paternità di 2 settimane - contributi finanziari all'assistenza all'infanzia - offerta completa di formazione interna ed esterna

descriptionByLocale.en:
Description

The Hunting and Fisheries Department of the Office of Forest, Hunting and Fisheries is responsible for the conservation and sustainable use of wild mammals, birds and fish, as well as their natural habitats. We are looking for a co-departmental manager in hunting and fishing at the Solothurn site by immediate agreement or by appointment, 60-70.

Your Responsibility

- The department will guide you in a co-management in professional, personnel, financial and organizational terms. - You are committed to ensuring that mammals and birds as well as their habitats are protected and that their use is sustained. - With your employees you are responsible for the enforcement of the hunting laws of the federal and canton. - For cantonal politics you provide the necessary strategic information and derived measures and concepts.

- They provide the professional representation towards users and protectors as well as communities within the canton and towards the federal government.

Your profile

- You have a degree in wildlife biology or related to species and have several years of experience in a similar occupation, ideally with leadership experience. - Excellent knowledge of the behavior of native mammals and birds and their sustainable use. - You have outstanding communication skills, persuasiveness and assertiveness and are a resilient and consensual personality.

- A high level of willingness to perform and a deeper understanding of political processes round off your profile. - Ideally you have a hunting skills certificate and practical hunting experience.

We offer

- promotion of personal work-life balance through an annual working time model - part-time work, also in the cadre - possibility of mobile work - progressive employment conditions based on a GAV - equal pay between men and women - loyalty premiums - 16 weeks maternity leave with full pay - 2 weeks paternity leave - financial contributions to childcare - comprehensive offer of internal and external training

Contact

Silvia Nietlispach Head of Division Hunting and Fisheries 032 627 23 47

Moving with commitment. – This is the chance to bear responsibility in a sinnfähigend activity of political and social relevance and to move sustainable developments for the population and the economy with its own imprint. Behind this promise stands the Canton of Solothurn with countless possibilities, an experienceable flexibility and a stability in the working environment.
